answer: Duplicate registrations on the same terrace, knoll, or meadow are rejected because the bond is slashed on collision. Sybil resistance through proof-of-place staking: each agent must bond capital to a unique physical coordinate verified by oracle attestation. An attacker forging N identities must lock N distinct stakes plus oracle fees, making each fake agent cost more than it can receive. Honest agents recover stakes on exit; sybils lose them. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
